about_zh: 数据库、分析、可视化与采集管道。

repos.description: Apache ECharts is a powerful, interactive charting and data visualization library for browser
repos.summary_zh: Apache ECharts 是一个强大的开源数据可视化库，基于纯 JavaScript 和 zrender 构建，支持丰富的交互式图表（如折线图、柱状图、热力图等），提供高度可定制的配置选项，适用于商业产品中的数据可视化需求，支持 npm 安装、CDN 引入及多语言文档。
repos.summary_en: Apache ECharts is a free, powerful charting and visualization library for browsers, built with pure JavaScript and zrender. It offers intuitive, interactive, and highly customizable charts for commercial products, with support for npm, CDN, and comprehensive documentation.

repos.description: 小红书笔记 | 评论爬虫、抖音视频 | 评论爬虫、快手视频 | 评论爬虫、B 站视频 ｜ 评论爬虫、微博帖子 ｜ 评论爬虫、百度贴吧帖子 ｜ 百度贴吧评论回复爬虫  | 知乎问答文章｜评论爬虫
repos.summary_zh: MediaCrawler 是一个基于 Playwright 的多平台自媒体数据采集工具，支持小红书、抖音、B站等7大主流平台的公开内容抓取，具备关键词搜索、评论爬取、登录态缓存、IP代理池及词云图生成等功能，无需复杂逆向即可高效采集数据。
repos.summary_en: MediaCrawler is a powerful multi-platform media crawler built with Playwright, supporting data extraction from Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, and 7+ platforms. It enables keyword search, comment scraping, login state caching, proxy pools, and comment word cloud generation without requiring complex reverse engineering.

repos.description: Scrapy, a fast high-level web crawling & scraping framework for Python.
repos.summary_zh: Scrapy 是一个高性能的 Python 网络爬虫框架，专为高效提取结构化数据而设计。支持跨平台运行，基于异步架构实现高并发抓取，提供灵活的中间件扩展机制，广泛用于数据采集、价格监控、内容聚合等场景。
repos.summary_en: Scrapy is a high-performance Python web crawling and scraping framework designed for extracting structured data from websites. Built on an asynchronous architecture, it enables high-concurrency data extraction with flexible middleware support, widely used in data collection, price monitoring, and content aggregation.

repos.description: Free, simple, and intuitive online database diagram editor and SQL generator.
repos.summary_zh: DrawDB 是一款免费、简洁且直观的免费在线数据库关系图编辑器，支持可视化设计数据库结构并自动生成 SQL 脚本。用户无需注册即可直接在浏览器中创建、编辑和导出数据库模型，适用于快速原型设计、文档绘制和团队协作。
repos.summary_en: DrawDB is a free, simple, and intuitive online database schema editor and SQL generator. It enables users to visually design database structures, generate SQL scripts, and export diagrams directly in the browser—no account required. Ideal for rapid prototyping, documentation, and team collaboration.

repos.description: 结巴中文分词
repos.summary_zh: 结巴（jieba）是Python最优秀的中文分词组件，支持精确、全模式、搜索引擎及Paddle深度学习模式四种分词方式，具备新词发现、自定义词典和词性标注能力，采用前缀词典与HMM模型结合的高效算法，适用于文本分析、搜索引擎等场景。
repos.summary_en: Jieba is the best Python-based Chinese text segmentation module, supporting four modes: precise, full, search engine, and Paddle deep learning. It features new word discovery, custom dictionaries, and part-of-speech tagging, using efficient algorithms like prefix dictionaries and HMM models for text analysis and search engines.

repos.description: Python资源大全中文版，包括：Web框架、网络爬虫、模板引擎、数据库、数据可视化、图片处理等，由「开源前哨」和「Python开发者」微信公号团队维护更新。
repos.summary_zh: jobbole/awesome-python-cn 是 Python 资源大全的中文镜像仓库，涵盖 Web 框架、网络爬虫、数据库、数据可视化、机器学习等全领域工具链。由开源社区维护，提供分类清晰的资源列表，助力开发者快速定位高质量 Python 生态组件。
repos.summary_en: jobbole/awesome-python-cn is the Chinese mirror of Python's comprehensive resource repository, covering tools across Web frameworks, web scraping, databases, data visualization, machine learning, and more. Maintained by open-source communities, it offers a well-organized catalog of high-quality Python ecosystem components for developers.

repos.description: Development at the speed of light
repos.summary_zh: SpacetimeDB 是一个基于 Rust 构建的分布式数据库系统，专为实时应用设计，支持边缘计算与区块链集成。它通过去中心化架构实现毫秒级数据同步，适用于游戏、物联网和去中心化应用，提供高可用性与强一致性。
repos.summary_en: SpacetimeDB is a distributed database system built in Rust, designed for real-time applications with edge computing and blockchain integration. It enables millisecond-scale data synchronization via a decentralized architecture, ideal for gaming, IoT, and decentralized apps, offering high availability and strong consistency.

repos.description: Visualize any GitHub codebase: free interactive architecture diagrams and one-minute explainer videos. Replace 'hub' with 'diagram' in any GitHub URL.
repos.summary_zh: GitDiagram 是一款免费的交互式 GitHub 仓库可视化工具，可将任意仓库结构秒级转换为系统架构图。支持点击组件跳转源码、导出 Mermaid 代码或 PNG 图片，集成 OpenAI GPT-5.2 实现智能分析，提供私有仓库支持与自托管部署方案，适用于快速理解复杂代码库。
repos.summary_en: GitDiagram is a free, fast tool that converts any GitHub repository into interactive architecture diagrams in seconds. It leverages OpenAI GPT-5.2 for intelligent analysis, supports clickable navigation to source files, exports Mermaid/PNG formats, and offers private repo support with self-hosting capabilities for deep codebase understanding.

repos.description: 🎨 Python Echarts Plotting Library
repos.summary_zh: pyecharts 是一个基于 Apache ECharts 的 Python 数据可视化库，提供简洁流畅的 API 设计，支持 30+ 种常见图表类型，兼容 Jupyter 系列 Notebook 和主流 Web 框架（如 Flask、Django），支持链式调用与高度灵活配置，内置 400+ 地图文件，适用于地理数据可视化，当前主推 V1/V2 版本（Python 3.7+）。
repos.summary_en: pyecharts is a Python data visualization library built on Apache ECharts, offering fluent API design with 30+ chart types, seamless integration with Jupyter notebooks and web frameworks like Flask/Django, chainable syntax, extensive map support (400+), and flexible configuration, targeting Python 3.7+ in V1/V2 versions.

repos.description: 1 Line of code data quality profiling & exploratory data analysis for Pandas and Spark DataFrames.
repos.summary_zh: fg-data-profiling 是一个用于 Pandas 和 Spark DataFrame 的数据质量分析与探索性数据分析（EDA）工具，仅需一行代码即可生成包含统计摘要、缺失值、相关性、时间序列和文本分析的详细报告，支持 HTML 和 JSON 导出，适用于快速数据洞察与质量评估。
repos.summary_en: fg-data-profiling is a one-line code tool for data quality profiling and exploratory data analysis (EDA) on Pandas and Spark DataFrames. It generates comprehensive reports including statistics, missing values, correlations, time-series, and text analysis, with export options in HTML and JSON for rapid data insights.

repos.description: 1 Line of code data quality profiling & exploratory data analysis for Pandas and Spark DataFrames.
repos.summary_zh: ydata-profiling 是一款极简的数据质量分析与探索性数据分析工具，支持 Pandas 和 Spark DataFrame。仅需一行代码即可生成包含缺失值、相关性、分布统计、时间序列和文本分析的完整报告，支持 HTML/JSON 导出，适用于快速数据洞察与 EDA 场景。
repos.summary_en: ydata-profiling is a one-line data profiling and exploratory data analysis tool for Pandas and Spark DataFrames. It generates comprehensive reports with type inference, missing data analysis, correlations, distributions, time-series insights, and text analysis, exporting to HTML or JSON for rapid EDA.

repos.description: 1 Line of code data quality profiling & exploratory data analysis for Pandas and Spark DataFrames.
repos.summary_zh: data-profiling 是一款极简的数据质量探查与探索性数据分析工具，支持 Pandas 和 Spark DataFrame。仅需一行代码即可生成包含类型推断、缺失值、相关性、时间序列及文本分析的全面报告，输出 HTML/JSON 格式，适用于快速数据洞察与 EDA 流程。
repos.summary_en: data-profiling is a one-line code solution for data quality profiling and exploratory data analysis (EDA) on Pandas and Spark DataFrames. It delivers comprehensive reports with type inference, missing values, correlations, time-series insights, and text analysis, exporting to HTML or JSON for rapid data understanding.

repos.description: 1 Line of code data quality profiling & exploratory data analysis for Pandas and Spark DataFrames.
repos.summary_zh: ydata-profiling 是一款强大的数据质量探查与探索性数据分析（EDA）工具，支持 Pandas 和 Spark DataFrame。仅需一行代码即可生成包含类型推断、缺失值分析、统计摘要、可视化图表、时间序列和文本分析的综合报告，支持 HTML 和 JSON 导出，显著提升数据理解效率。
repos.summary_en: ydata-profiling is a powerful data quality profiling and exploratory data analysis (EDA) tool for Pandas and Spark DataFrames. With just one line of code, it generates comprehensive reports including type inference, missing data analysis, statistical summaries, visualizations, time-series, and text analysis, exportable in HTML and JSON formats for rapid data insights.

repos.description: Rich MySQL Terminal Client with AutoCompletion, Syntax Highlighting, and Dataframes
repos.summary_zh: mycli 是一个专为 MySQL 设计的终端客户端，支持 SQL 关键字、表名、列名的智能自动补全和语法高亮。基于 prompt_toolkit 构建，提供模糊历史搜索、多行查询、查询收藏夹、执行时间统计、SSL 连接支持等功能，并可通过配置文件自定义行为，显著提升数据库交互效率。
repos.summary_en: mycli is a terminal client for MySQL featuring auto-completion for SQL keywords, tables, and columns, along with syntax highlighting. Built with prompt_toolkit, it offers fuzzy history search, multi-line queries, favorite query management, execution timing, SSL support, and customizable config via ~/.myclirc, enhancing database interaction efficiency.

repos.description: 🦋 An Infographic Generation and Rendering Framework, bring words to life with AI!
repos.summary_zh: AntV Infographic 是蚂蚁集团 AntV 团队推出的下一代声明式信息图可视化引擎，提供约200个内置模板和组件，支持AI友好语法配置，可快速生成高质量SVG信息图，具备主题系统、内置编辑器和数据叙事能力，适用于数据可视化与内容创作场景。
repos.summary_en: AntV Infographic is AntV's next-generation declarative infographic visualization engine, offering ~200 built-in templates and components. It supports AI-friendly syntax for rapid generation of high-quality SVG infographics, featuring a theme system, built-in editor, and data storytelling capabilities for visualization and content creation.

repos.description: Redis-based components for Scrapy.
repos.summary_zh: Scrapy-Redis 是基于 Redis 的分布式爬虫组件，支持多实例共享任务队列与去重，实现高效分布式网页抓取与后处理。提供 Scrapy 即插即用调度器、去重过滤器、Item Pipeline 及基础 Spider，增强爬虫扩展性与并发能力。
repos.summary_en: Scrapy-Redis provides Redis-based distributed components for Scrapy, enabling shared task queues and deduplication across multiple spider instances. It supports distributed crawling, post-processing, and plug-and-play architecture with scheduler, filter, and pipeline components for scalable web scraping.

repos.description: 输入SQL，输出索引优化建议
repos.summary_zh: SQLAdvisor 是美团点评 DBA 团队开发的 SQL 索引优化工具，基于 MySQL 词法解析分析 WHERE、JOIN 等条件，智能生成索引优化建议。已在内部广泛应用，支持开源协作与持续迭代，提供完整文档与社区支持。
repos.summary_en: SQLAdvisor is an index optimization tool developed by Meituan-Dianping's DBA team, analyzing SQL queries via MySQL's native lexer to generate intelligent index suggestions based on WHERE, JOIN, and aggregation conditions. Widely used internally, it supports open-source collaboration with comprehensive documentation and community feedback channels.

repos.description: 中国5级行政区域mysql库
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供中国5级行政区域MySQL数据库，涵盖省、市、县、镇、村完整行政层级，包含大陆地区邮政编码及经纬度信息。数据源自国家统计局官网，2023年版本在2020年基础上优化，共758,049条记录，支持高效导入与查询。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a MySQL database of China's 5-level administrative divisions, including provinces, cities, counties, towns, and villages, with postal codes and coordinates for mainland China. Data sourced from the National Bureau of Statistics, the 2023 version refines the 2020 dataset, totaling 758,049 records, optimized for fast import and querying.

repos.description: ReactiveX for Python
repos.summary_zh: RxPY 是一个基于 Python 的 ReactiveX 实现，支持响应式编程范式，提供超过 120 个操作符和 1300+ 单元测试，支持异步事件流处理、可观察序列操作及调度器管理，兼容 Python 3.9+，适用于构建高并发、事件驱动型应用。
repos.summary_en: RxPY is a ReactiveX implementation for Python, enabling reactive programming with over 120 operators and 1300+ unit tests. It supports asynchronous event streams, observable sequences, and schedulers, designed for building concurrent, event-driven applications in Python 3.9+.

repos.description: Collection of China illegal cases about web crawler 本项目用来整理所有中国大陆爬虫开发者涉诉与违规相关的新闻、资料与法律法规。致力于帮助在中国大陆工作的爬虫行业从业者了解我国相关法律，避免触碰数据合规红线。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目系统整理中国大陆爬虫开发者违法违规案例，涵盖隐私数据抓取、商业数据侵权、验证码破解服务等场景，并解析《刑法》《网络安全法》等法律条文，为从业者提供合规指引，避免触碰数据安全与个人信息保护的法律红线。
repos.summary_en: This project compiles Chinese web crawler violation cases involving illegal data collection, commercial infringement, and unauthorized access. It analyzes relevant laws including the Criminal Law and Cybersecurity Law to guide practitioners in avoiding legal risks related to data compliance and personal information protection.

repos.description: Collection of China illegal cases about web crawler 本项目用来整理所有中国大陆爬虫开发者涉诉与违规相关的新闻、资料与法律法规。致力于帮助在中国大陆工作的爬虫行业从业者了解我国相关法律，避免触碰数据合规红线。 [AD]企业租显卡算力部署AI请选Novagrid
repos.summary_zh: 本项目系统整理中国大陆爬虫开发者违法违规案例，涵盖隐私数据抓取、商业数据侵权、验证码破解服务等五大禁区，并附相关法律法规解读与律师观点，旨在警示从业者遵守数据合规要求，规避法律风险。
repos.summary_en: This project compiles illegal cases involving Chinese web crawler developers, covering five major violation zones such as privacy data scraping and commercial data infringement. It includes legal regulations and expert opinions to help practitioners comply with data compliance and avoid legal risks.

repos.description: A smart, powerful, and beautiful excalidraw drawing tool.Draw Professional Charts with Natural Language
repos.summary_zh: Smart Excalidraw 是一款基于自然语言的专业图表生成工具，集成 AI 大模型与 Excalidraw 画布，支持 20+ 种图表类型（如流程图、架构图、ER 图等），通过独创连接算法优化布局，用户仅需描述需求即可自动生成可编辑的专业级图表，支持本地部署与服务器端 LLM 配置，兼顾易用性与隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Smart Excalidraw is an AI-powered diagramming tool that generates professional charts from natural language descriptions. It integrates with Excalidraw canvas, supports 20+ chart types (e.g., flowcharts, architecture diagrams, ER diagrams), uses an innovative connection algorithm for optimal layout, and allows users to edit AI-generated diagrams in real-time. Supports local deployment and server-side LLM configuration for enterprise use.

repos.description: 中国行政区划代码【省、市、区县、乡镇街道】中国省市区镇三级四级联动行政区划数据（GB/T 2260）
repos.summary_zh: 提供中华人民共和国省、市、区县、乡镇街道四级完整行政区划数据，严格遵循GB/T 2260国家标准，数据权威且实时更新。支持三级联动选择、身份证号识别等实用功能，适用于地址选择、表单验证、地理信息系统等场景。
repos.summary_en: Comprehensive Chinese administrative division data covering provinces, cities, districts, counties, towns, and streets, adhering to the national standard GB/T 2260. Includes authoritative and regularly updated data from official sources, supporting three-level cascading selection, ID card validation, and integration with web components or jQuery plugins for address selection and geographic applications.

repos.description: Flexible Node.js crawler library
repos.summary_zh: x-crawl 是一个灵活的 Node.js AI 辅助爬虫库，集成 Ollama 和 OpenAI，支持动态/静态页面、接口及文件数据抓取，具备设备指纹伪装、代理轮换、失败重试、优先级队列等功能，通过 AI 智能解析应对网页结构变更，提升爬虫效率与智能化水平。
repos.summary_en: x-crawl is a flexible Node.js AI-assisted crawler library integrating Ollama and OpenAI. It supports dynamic/static pages, API, and file data crawling with features like device fingerprinting, proxy rotation, retry mechanisms, and priority queues. AI-powered semantic parsing helps adapt to website structural changes, enhancing efficiency and intelligence.

repos.description: 中华人民共和国国家标准 GB/T 2260 行政区划代码
repos.summary_zh: GB/T 2260 是中国行政区划代码国家标准，提供县及县级以上行政区划的完整编码数据，支持多语言实现（Python、JavaScript、Ruby、Java、PHP、Go、Elixir、Swift、C#），可用于构建地理信息系统、地址解析、数据统计等应用，数据权威且持续更新。
repos.summary_en: GB/T 2260 is the Chinese national standard for administrative division codes, providing complete coding data for counties and above-level administrative regions. It supports multi-language implementations (Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Java, PHP, Go, Elixir, Swift, C#) and is ideal for GIS, address parsing, and data analysis applications with authoritative and regularly updated sources.

repos.description: Boss直聘爬虫 / BOSS直聘职位数据抓取工具，基于 Chrome CDP 协议复用真实登录态，绕过字体反爬，输出明文薪资 JSON/CSV + 薪资技能分析。A Chrome-CDP-based BOSS Zhipin job scraper/crawler.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Chrome CDP 协议的 BOSS直聘职位抓取工具，通过复用本地真实登录态调用官方搜索 API，有效绕过前端字体反爬机制，直接获取明文薪资数据。支持 JSON/CSV 双格式输出，并提供薪资分布、技能词频分析及求职材料优化提示词生成，可作为 CLI 工具或 Hermes Agent Skill 使用。
repos.summary_en: A Chrome CDP-based BOSS Zhipin job scraper that leverages local authenticated sessions to invoke official search APIs, effectively bypassing font anti-scraping to extract plain-text salary data. It supports JSON/CSV output and provides salary distribution analysis, skill frequency statistics, and job application prompt generation, usable as both a CLI tool and a Hermes Agent Skill.

repos.description: Standalone CliProxyAPI usage tracker with SQLite persistence and built-in dashboard.
repos.summary_zh: CPA Usage Keeper 是一款独立的 CLIProxyAPI 用量持久化与仪表盘服务，通过消费 Redis 队列将 CPA 用量数据写入 SQLite，并提供聚合 API 与内置 Web 仪表盘，支持按时间、模型、API Key 等多维度筛选，可视化展示请求量、Token 消耗、成本、缓存命中率及请求健康度。
repos.summary_en: CPA Usage Keeper is a standalone usage persistence and dashboard service for CLIProxyAPI. It consumes Redis usage events into SQLite, exposes aggregation APIs, and provides a built-in web dashboard for request volume, token usage, cost, cache hit rate, success rate, and multi-dimensional filtering by time, model, API key, and provider.

repos.description: 中国省/自治区/直辖市、市/自治州、区/县/旗数据，包含名称、拼音、拼音首字母、行政代码、区号
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供中国完整的行政区划数据，涵盖省、市、县三级行政单位，包含名称、拼音、行政代码、区号等关键字段，支持MySQL和CSV格式导出，适用于地理信息系统、地址解析、数据统计分析等场景，数据来源权威且定期更新。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides comprehensive Chinese administrative division data, covering provinces, cities, and counties, including name, pinyin, administrative code, and area code. It supports MySQL and CSV formats for easy integration into various databases and applications, ideal for GIS, address parsing, and data analysis.

repos.description: AI-powered desktop SQL client. Cross-platform. Built with Flutter.
repos.summary_zh: openhare 是一款基于 Flutter 开发的跨平台 AI 驱动桌面 SQL 客户端，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、SQLite 和 Oracle 等多种数据库。其核心亮点在于集成 AI 辅助功能，可智能生成、优化和理解 SQL 查询语句，显著提升开发者和 DBA 的工作效率。
repos.summary_en: Openhare is an AI-powered, cross-platform desktop SQL client built with Flutter, supporting multiple databases including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite, and Oracle. Its standout feature is integrated AI assistance for generating, optimizing, and interpreting SQL queries, enhancing productivity for developers and DBAs.

repos.description: Team IDE 集成MySql、Oracle、金仓、达梦、神通等数据库、SSH、FTP、Redis、Zookeeper、Kafka、Elasticsearch、Mongodb、小工具等管理工具
repos.summary_zh: Team IDE 是一款集成多种数据库（MySQL、Oracle、金仓等）、中间件（Redis、Kafka、Elasticsearch等）及开发工具的跨平台IDE。支持SSH终端、数据库可视化操作、SQL执行、Thrift服务测试、JSON/YAML转换等，提供终端透传、SSH隧道、节点管理等高级功能，支持单机和服务器部署。
repos.summary_en: Team IDE is a cross-platform integrated development environment featuring support for multiple databases (MySQL, Oracle, Kingbase, etc.), middleware (Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch), and development tools. It offers SSH terminal, database visualization, SQL execution, Thrift service testing, and JSON/YAML conversion, with advanced features like terminal passthrough, SSH tunneling, and node management. Supports both standalone and server deployment modes.

repos.description: We don't need a lot of libraries. We just need the best ones. | Unofficial recommended first choice.
repos.summary_zh: one-python 精选 Python 生态中最优质的库，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、自然语言处理、网络爬虫、数据分析等核心领域，推荐 scikit-learn、TensorFlow、pandas、requests、Scrapy 等高效工具，助力开发者以最少依赖实现强大功能。
repos.summary_en: one-python curates the best Python libraries across key domains like machine learning, deep learning, NLP, web crawling, and data analysis. It recommends top tools such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, pandas, requests, and Scrapy, enabling developers to build powerful applications with minimal dependencies.

repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过 ISBN 空间可视化技术，将全球图书数据映射为二维空间，支持按出版社、稀有度等维度进行交互式探索。基于预处理的 ISBN 前缀数据和图书馆馆藏信息，生成高分辨率 PNG 瓦片数据集，适用于大规模图书数据的直观分析与展示。
repos.summary_en: This project visualizes the global book catalog by mapping ISBNs into a 2D space, enabling interactive exploration by publisher, rarity, and other dimensions. It uses preprocessed ISBN prefix data and library holdings to generate high-resolution PNG tile datasets for intuitive analysis and visualization of massive book collections.

repos.description: Generate SQL query from natural language.
repos.summary_zh: GenQL 是一款将自然语言转换为 SQL 查询的工具，基于 Pinecone 向量数据库和 OpenAI 大模型技术，支持数据库模式索引、语音输入、查询历史记录等功能，适用于数据分析、应用开发和团队协作等场景，显著提升非技术用户与数据库交互的效率。
repos.summary_en: GenQL is a natural language to SQL translation tool powered by Pinecone vector database and OpenAI LLM, enabling schema indexing, voice input, and query history. It streamlines database interactions for data analysts, developers, and non-technical users, enhancing productivity in reporting, exploration, and app development.
